# wrs: the write strobes of R8, R9, R10 and R11 from the strobe tracks (trace/bd3.txt, T3-T6, drawn
# there west to x 14090) to the four register rows of the central datapath. Notes:
# notes/blocks/wrs.md. Four parallel lines, nested all the way:
#   metal west along y 17128 / 17170 / 17214 / 17258, poly under the vertical trunks (pads at
#   x 13386 / 13430 and 12805 / 12850), metal west to x 11506-11636, north, a step west at
#   y 14618-14748, north along x 11418-11549, a long 45-degree diagonal up to the central datapath's
#   east edge (x 10982-11113 at y 10167-10236), then north with one 44 px step west above each
#   place where the innermost line ends on its register row's strobe poly.
# All metal from tools/follow.py; the steps located by running it with --max in 50 px stages.
@block wrs
@requires bd3
@requires cdp1
@requires cdp2
@w M=12 P=18
@s 26x26
